0003.name: vga_init_entry
0003.comment: Option-ROM init entry (called far by system BIOS during POST)

2C44.name: int10_handler
2C44.comment: INT 10h video services entry installed by init (also INT 6Dh, the VGA private copy of INT 10h).

267D.name: vga_init_main
267D.comment: Option ROM init body: unlock C&T extension regs (3D6h idx 6Fh), INT 15h AX=5F34h platform hook, detect warm boot (40:72=1234h), set BDA video fields, install vectors, set default mode.

297C.name: install_far_vector
297C.comment: ES:DI -> IVT slot; stores AX (offset) then BX (segment).

2679.name: seg_word_2
2679.comment: Segment word used for the second vector group (see 2968).

019E.name: video_save_ptr_table
019E.comment: EGA/VGA SAVE_PTR table, address stored at 40:A8 (points to parameter tables, palette, font override).

017D.name: config_flags_17D
017D.comment: Feature/configuration flag bytes tested by init (bit 6 at 17D, bit 4 at 17F).

0AF3.name: mode_entry_table_0AF3
0AF3.comment: 4-byte records per mode (flags byte, panel byte, pointer to the 64-byte parameter block in mode_parameter_tables); pairs of records exist for modes that have a flat-panel variant (panel_mode_check_advance_di). Followed at 0B4B by (register, value) lists for the C&T extension registers.

44C0.name: int10_11_font_dispatch
44C0.comment: INT 10h AH=11h (character generator) dispatch: 25 near pointers indexed by AL low nibble | (AL bits 4-5 >> 1): 00-04 load fonts, 10-14 load and reprogram the CRTC for the new height, 20-24 set the INT 1Fh/43h pointers, 30 get font information.

2C08.name: int10_dispatch_table
2C08.comment: 29 near pointers for INT 10h AH=00h..1Ch. AH>=1Dh goes to the C&T extension handler (sub_206A) or chains to INT 42h (system BIOS video).

206A.name: int10_5F_dispatch
206A.comment: C&T extended functions: AH must be 5Fh; AL=10h is aliased to 03h; maps AL to ct5F_function_table. For indexes < 20 the call is bracketed by a mode save/restore (40:49, sequencer index).

6C54.name: font_9x14_supplement
6C54.comment: 9-dot alternate glyphs for the 8x14 font (char code + 14 bytes each, 0-terminated).

7D64.name: font_9x16_supplement
7D64.comment: 9-dot alternate glyphs for the 8x16 font (char code + 16 bytes each, 0-terminated).

2932.name: install_int42_save_sysvideo
2932.comment: INT 42h := F000:F065 (system BIOS INT 10h saved for chaining).

426A.name: int10_10_dac_dispatch
426A.comment: 28 near pointers for INT 10h AH=10h AL=00h..1Bh (palette/DAC/overscan functions).

471A.name: int10_12_bl30_dispatch
471A.comment: 7 near pointers for INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h..36h (scan lines, palette load, video enable, gray sum, cursor emulation, display switch, refresh).

4753.name: int10_12_bl10_get_ega_info
4753.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=10h: returns BH = mono/colour (40:487 bit 1), BL = memory size code 3 (256 KB), CH = feature bits, CL = switch settings (40:488).

477F.name: int10_12_bl20_alt_prtsc
477F.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=20h: selects the alternate print-screen routine (IVT 05h := int05_print_screen, which handles more than 25 rows).

4CFC.name: int10_1C_state_dispatch
4CFC.comment: 3 near pointers for INT 10h AH=1Ch AL=0/1/2 (state buffer size / save / restore).

203C.name: ct5F_function_table
203C.comment: 22 near pointers: AH=5Fh AL=00h..04h at [0..4], AL=50h..5Fh at [4..19], AL=A0h..A2h at [20..22]. Index 4 is shared by AL=04h and AL=50h.

0F6B.name: ct5F5C_subfn_table
0F6B.comment: 18 near pointers for ct5F5C_panel_adjust, indexed by BL.

202C.name: ct_ext_read
202C.comment: AL = C&T extension register index (port 3D6h) -> AH = value; DX left at 3D6h.

2033.name: ct_ext_read_0F
2033.comment: Read C&T extension register 0Fh (panel/CRT status) -> AH.

23E6.name: ct_ext44_read_panel_type
23E6.comment: Read extension register 44h; DL = bits 0-1 (panel type), ZF set if 0.

508A.name: idx_reg_read_next
508A.comment: DX = index port, AL = index: out index, read data from DX+1 -> AH; AL = index+1 (for sequential reads).

509E.name: idx_reg_read_word
509E.comment: DX = index port, AL = index: out AL, in AX -> AH = value, AL = index.

50A9.name: ct_ext_write
50A9.comment: AL = extension register index, AH = value -> 3D6h/3D7h.

50D0.name: speaker_beep
50D0.comment: AL = port 61h gate bits; programs PIT ch2 (43h=B6h) and beeps - used for the init error codes (sub_2A2C) and BEL in teletype.

52B7.name: screen_off
52B7.comment: Sequencer clocking-mode register bit 5 := 1 (blank display during reprogramming).

52C7.name: seq_clocking_screen_bit
52C7.comment: CL = bit-5 value for sequencer register 01h (screen off/on).

441C.name: attr_reg_read
441C.comment: Wait for vertical retrace, then read attribute-controller register BL -> BH (restores index flip-flop).

3F6F.name: attr_reg_write
3F6F.comment: Wait for vertical retrace, write attribute-controller register BL := BH, re-enable palette (20h).

3F51.name: save_ptr_palette_store
3F51.comment: If SAVE_PTR (40:A8) has a dynamic palette save area, store BH at offset BL in it.

4474.name: dac_write_rgb
4474.comment: Write one DAC entry: index in AL? (via 3C8h), R/G/B from AH/CH/CL.

527F.name: dac_read_rgb
527F.comment: Read one DAC entry via 3C7h/3C9h -> AH, CH, CL.

1518.name: get_current_mode
1518.comment: AH = 40:49 & 7Fh (current mode without the no-clear bit).

1F3F.name: mode_class_flags
1F3F.comment: AH = mode number -> BL class flags for C&T extended modes (14h-5Fh: 45h; 66h+: bit0 graphics, 71h+: bit6 packed, 78h+: bit2); CF/ZF used by callers to pick text/planar/packed code paths.

17E2.name: find_mode_record
17E2.comment: AL = mode -> search mode_list (count at 0ADC, bytes at 0ADD); ZF=1 if found, DI = index*4 into mode_records (0AF3).

181B.name: get_mode_param_ptr
181B.comment: SI = pointer to the mode's parameter table (word at mode_records+2).

180E.name: get_mode_flag_byte
180E.comment: AL = first byte of the mode record (memory model/flags).

0ADC.name: mode_number_list
0ADC.comment: Count byte then the mode numbers handled by find_mode_record (standard and C&T extended modes); index -> 4-byte record in mode_entry_table_0AF3.

0C46.name: panel_active_check
0C46.comment: ZF from extension register 51h bit 2 (flat panel enabled).

0C5D.name: crt_panel_present_check
0C5D.comment: Reads extension register 06h (when config 17F bit 5) to determine CRT/panel presence; returns comparison flags.

2E8C.name: call_int15_5F_hook
2E8C.comment: AX = 5F33h/5F34h/5F38h: platform hook into the system BIOS INT 15h AH=5Fh handler (mode change notifications for the panel controller).

2D54.name: set_mode_body
2D54.comment: Mode set implementation: loads the mode parameter table (CRTC, sequencer, graphics, attribute), fonts and BDA fields.

5635.name: check_mode_load_es
5635.comment: Validates the current mode for the calling service and loads ES from the caller frame; ZF=1 means 'not applicable' (used by 10h/11h/13h/1Bh/1Ch).

4B19.name: get_display_combination
4B19.comment: CL/CH = active/alternate display combination codes for INT 10h 1Ah.

4D6C.name: state_buffer_size
4D6C.comment: CX = requested state components (bits 0-2) -> AX = buffer size in 64-byte blocks (INT 10h 1Ch AL=0, 5FA0h).

4D82.name: save_video_state
4D82.comment: INT 10h 1Ch AL=1 for CX=2 (BIOS data area only).

215E.name: save_hardware_state
215E.comment: INT 10h 1Ch save of video hardware registers (+ DAC when CX bit 2).

224E.name: restore_hardware_state
224E.comment: INT 10h 1Ch restore of video hardware registers.

4124.name: cga_pixel_address
4124.comment: CGA modes 4-6: ES=B800h, DI = 40h*(DY/2) + (DX/2 or /4) + 2000h for odd rows; AH = pixel mask, CL = shift (2 bpp or 1 bpp).

3B9A.name: text_cell_address
3B9A.comment: BH = page, DX = row/col -> ES:DI address of the character cell in text memory.

394A.name: read_char_attr_body
394A.comment: AH=08h implementation: text modes read the word directly; CGA modes reverse-match the glyph rows against the font (sub_3B5F); planar via 1D43; mode 13h via 3ADD.

34C8.name: scroll_text
34C8.comment: Text-mode scroll: row-by-row `rep movsw` then `rep stosw` of blank cells with attribute BH; waits for CGA retrace on real CGA (40:87 bit 2). DF set for scroll-down.

35D2.name: scroll_cga
35D2.comment: Graphics scroll for CGA modes 4-6: moves both 2000h-interleaved banks with movsw/movsb, 140h bytes per row, 4 or 8 scan lines per text row.

374E.name: scroll_planar
374E.comment: Graphics scroll for planar modes (0Dh-12h and extended): write mode 1 (GC 05h=01h) copies latches with `rep movsb` through all planes at once, then fills the vacated rows via set/reset (GC 00h/01h) with `rep stosb`.

3856.name: scroll_mode13_down
3856.comment: Mode 13h scroll-down entry (DF set, start at last row).

3884.name: scroll_mode13
3884.comment: Mode 13h (256-colour packed) scroll: 8 bytes per character column, `rep movsw` per text row, fill with attribute byte in AL and AH.

3CDA.name: write_char_cga
3CDA.comment: CGA graphics modes: glyph from INT 43h (or INT 1Fh for chars 80h-FFh), 8 rows split across the two interleaved banks; XOR when BL bit 7 (3D3E), colour expansion via planar_char_row_write for 2 bpp (3D5B).

3D81.name: write_char_planar
3D81.comment: Planar modes: address = page base + row*bytes_per_char_row + col; GC 00h set/reset = colour, GC 01h enable set/reset = ~colour bits, optional XOR via GC 03h=18h; sequencer map mask 0Fh; then one `movsb` per glyph row with DI += bytes/row (loops at 3DE6/3E0F).

3E25.name: write_char_mode13
3E25.comment: Mode 13h: expands each glyph row bit by bit into 8 bytes (BL foreground, BH background), 138h skip to the next scan line.

3E7F.name: planar_char_row_write
3E7F.comment: Expands one 8-pixel glyph row into a 16-bit 2-bpp pattern with colour BH and stores (or XORs when BL bit 7) it at ES:DI.

3E04.name: write_char_planar_xor
3E04.comment: XOR variant of the planar glyph loop (GC data-rotate function = XOR).

4008.name: write_pixel_planar
4008.comment: Planar modes: DI = y*bytes_per_row + x/8 (+ page*44Ch), GC 00h set/reset = colour, 01h enable = 0Fh, 08h bitmask = 80h>>(x&7); read-modify-write `or [bx],al` latches the plane data; XOR mode via GC 03h = 18h. Restores GC 00h/01h/08h afterwards.

4058.name: write_pixel_page_offset
4058.comment: Adds BH pages of 40:4C page size before the planar pixel write.

4078.name: read_pixel_mode13
4078.comment: Mode 13h: AL = byte at A000:(y*140h + x).

4098.name: read_pixel_cga
4098.comment: CGA modes 4-6: cga_pixel_address, mask and shift the pixel bits.

40D4.name: read_pixel_planar
40D4.comment: Planar modes: GC 04h read-map-select 3..0, read the byte for each plane, collect the pixel bit into CL.

3F94.name: write_pixel_mode13
3F94.comment: Mode 13h: byte store at A000:(y*140h + x) (also handles XOR when AL bit 7).

3FB8.name: write_pixel_cga
3FB8.comment: CGA modes 4-6: cga_pixel_address, then mask/shift/OR or XOR the pixel bits.

20C6.name: ct5F00_get_controller_info
20C6.comment: Returns AL=5Fh, BL = extension register 00h (chip/version ID), BH = ext 04h & 3 (video memory size code), CX = 0114h (BIOS version 1.14), DX = 0, AH = 1.

20F2.name: ct5F02_set_display_type
20F2.comment: BH = FFh: sub_12E1 (auto/default); BH = 2..7: sub_16B3 (select panel/CRT combination).

0D51.name: ct5F03_get_display_config
0D51.comment: Returns BX/CX/DX/SI/DI describing the current display configuration (sub_0D6B: panel size class from ext 0Fh, CRTC 01h width, row height), AX = 015Fh.

0DB3.name: ct5F04_get_panel_info
0DB3.comment: Returns BX = panel width (cs:01D6), CX = panel height (cs:01D8), DL flags: bit0 panel type, bit1 CRT present, bit2 ext 61h/63h bit7, bit3 ...; DH flags from ext 0Fh/57h. Also serves AL=50h.

0E28.name: ct5F51_select_display_device
0E28.comment: BL = 0 CRT / 1 LCD / 2 both: rewrites extension register 1Fh bits 0-1 and reprograms the current mode (screen off, CRTC/panel timing reload, gray-scale mapping) then screen on. Skipped if 1Fh bit 3 (locked).

0F33.name: ct5F5A_set_ext61_bit7
0F33.comment: Sets bit 7 of extension register 61h (or 63h depending on sequencer 04h memory mode) from BL bit 0 - panel-related enable (best guess: backlight/panel power).

0F8F.name: ct5F5C_panel_adjust
0F8F.comment: BL = 0..11h selects a panel geometry adjustment through ct5F5C_subfn_table (text/graphics stretching, vertical compensation, horizontal centering via extension registers 51h/57h/58h/59h/5Ah/24h).

11B1.name: ct5F5E_set_video_polarity
11B1.comment: BL=0/1: normal/reverse video (ext 59h bit 7, 0Fh bit 7, 57h bit 2); BL=2/3: ext 57h bit 1; BL=4/5: sub_141A/sub_140C. Matches SETUP 'Normal / Reverse'.

113F.name: ct5F5F_color_mapping
113F.comment: BL = 0..7 (0Fh -> 8) via ct5F5F_subfn_table: gray-scale / colour mapping controls in extension registers 55h/56h (SETUP 'MaxContrast / SmartMap').

2126.name: ct5FA0_get_state_size
2126.comment: CX = components -> AX = save buffer size (same as INT 10h 1Ch AL=0).

213E.name: ct5FA1_save_restore_state
213E.comment: Extended save/restore entry (continues into the 1Ch code).

0FFE.name: panel_adjust_text_stretch
0FFE.comment: BL 0..3: extension register 57h bits 0-1 (text mode vertical stretching), then 51h bit 6.

1032.name: panel_adjust_center
1032.comment: BL 4..5: horizontal/vertical centering offsets in ext 59h/58h.

1075.name: panel_adjust_ext24_5A
1075.comment: BL 6/0Ah: extension registers 24h or 5Ah low nibble := DL.

1093.name: panel_adjust_ext57_bits
1093.comment: BL 0Ch/0Eh: clear ext 57h bit 2 or 5 and read 0Fh.

10ED.name: panel_adjust_mode_bits
10ED.comment: Common tail: ext 57h masked (9Eh/E2h) | BH, then ext 51h bit 6 := CH.

1107.name: panel_adjust_enable_panel
1107.comment: ext 44h bit 4 := 1, then INT 10h AX=5F5Eh BL=0 (normal video).

111A.name: panel_adjust_disable_panel
111A.comment: ext 44h bit 4 := 0, then INT 10h AX=5F5Eh BL=1.

12E1.name: set_default_display
12E1.comment: Best guess: restore the display device selection to the CMOS/default choice.

16B3.name: set_display_device_bh
16B3.comment: Best guess: select panel/CRT combination given in BH/BL.

2A2C.name: init_error_beep_code
2A2C.comment: AL = error code (3 = DAC test failed, 4 = video memory test failed): beeps the code with speaker_beep.

2E12.name: set_mode_internal
2E12.comment: Mode set used by init (AL = mode, AH = 40:88 value).

4501.name: int10_11_packed_dispatch
4501.comment: INT 10h AH=11h: packs AL (low nibble | bits 4-5 >> 1) and jumps through int10_11_font_dispatch (25 entries).

5099.name: idx_reg_read_byte
5099.comment: DX = index port, AL = index -> AL = data (from DX+1).

0005.name: rom_header_text
0005.comment: '7400000000...' header/version text after the option ROM signature.

0047.name: mode_parameter_tables
0047.comment: Video mode parameter blocks (64 bytes each: columns, rows, character height, page size, sequencer 1-4, misc output, CRTC 0-18h, attribute 0-13h, graphics 0-8) for the standard and C&T extended modes; 0047-08BE.

4794.name: int10_12_ext_dispatch
4794.comment: 12 near pointers (47E2 47DD 47D8 47F2 480C 4807 4821 481C 4836 4831 484B 4846) for the extended INT 10h 12h sub-functions.

4B48.name: table_4B48
4B48.comment: Word table 0010 x4, 0004 x2, 0002 ... (plane/colour masks, best guess).

5116.name: supported_mode_list
5116.comment: Mode numbers 00-0E, 11, 12, 1A, 1B, 1C ... supported by this ROM.

14EF.name: ct_xr15_read_check
14EF.comment: C&T XR15 read, compares AH with 18h.

2665.name: ct_xr10_xr11_write
2665.comment: C&T extension registers XR10 := BL, XR11 := BH (3D6h/3D7h).

0C93.name: mode_set_xr0F_bits
0C93.comment: 40:489 &= F9h, then XR0F bits 2-3 cleared (panel/CRT mode bits) as part of the mode set.

0D3A.name: display_device_set_both
0D3A.comment: Sets the CRT output (BH=3, from CH) and the panel output (BH=2, from CL) through display_device_query_hook / set_display_device_bh.

0D6B.name: ct5F03_config_build
0D6B.comment: Builds the INT 10h 5F03h reply: XR0F bits 0-1 select the entry size (8/16) in the configuration table at 0196h.

0EE6.name: crtc_load_from_table
0EE6.comment: CRTC 11h := 0 (unlock), then CX CRTC registers from ES:[SI+AX] in index order.

0EFC.name: gc06_graphics_bit_test
0EFC.comment: ZF = !(GC 06h bit 0) - text vs graphics memory map.

0F0B.name: xr6C_xr04_adjust
0F0B.comment: XR6C bit 1 -> XR04 bit 5 (clock / interlace select, best guess).

0FAB.name: mono_text_mode_fixup
0FAB.comment: ROM flag 0194h bit 6 and mode 3 or 7: text_mode_panel_adjust.

0FC8.name: text_mode_panel_adjust
0FC8.comment: Panel-specific CRTC/XR adjustments for the text modes (uses the current mode number).

10B5.name: panel_mode_15_or_ext8
10B5.comment: Graphics memory map + XR0F bit 7 -> extended mode 8 (ext_mode_set_8_or_9), else panel_adjust_mode_bits BH=15h.

115E.name: xr55_clear_bits_by_bl
115E.comment: XR55 &= FEh / FBh / DFh depending on BL (panel line-count class).

1234.name: xr0F_bit7_test
1234.comment: ZF clear when XR0F bit 7 is set (extended-mode flag).

1241.name: panel_lines_class
1241.comment: BH := 0 for panels up to 480 lines (ROM word 01D8h), 1 up to 768, else 3.

1258.name: xr24_xr57_panel_program
1258.comment: XR24 := 14h/12h/1Dh/1Fh by panel class, then panel_adjust_mode_bits (BH=15h for extended mode 8, else 1Dh).

129D.name: xr57_set_22_xr59_xr5A
129D.comment: XR57 |= 22h; for non-480 panels XR59 |= 80h; XR5A := 01h/04h.

1302.name: mode_set_panel_regs
1302.comment: Panel register programming for the new mode (xr28 bits, centering, expansion).

13D9.name: mode_set_256color_fix
13D9.comment: For 256-colour modes (mode flag 20h): GC 05h := 40h, CRTC 13h halved, CRTC 0Ch/0Dh := FFh, ATC 13h := 07h.

140C.name: xr57_set_bit5
140C.comment: XR57 |= 20h (panel expansion / centering bit, best guess).

1462.name: mode_set_panel_type_check
1462.comment: xr06_program_by_mode, then when the panel is active and XR44 bit 7 is clear display_device_set_both.

1526.name: panel_regs_from_table
1526.comment: ROM flag 0194h bit 5 and panel active: loads the panel register list selected by panel_regs_table_by_type.

15B9.name: xr2D_program_panel
15B9.comment: ROM flag 0194h bit 4: XR2D := 51h/55h/53h by class and CRT presence.

15DA.name: display_device_query_hook
15DA.comment: INT 15h AX=5F39h hook with the current mode, then table 0188h lookup - asks the system BIOS which display is wanted.

1652.name: mode_set_int15_5F39_hook
1652.comment: Calls INT 15h 5F39h for the new mode and picks the ROM default (0182h/0184h) when the hook does not answer.

1858.name: nop_push_pop_1858
1858.comment: push ax; xor ax,ax; pop ax; ret (hook placeholder).

185D.name: bank_regs_save_set
185D.comment: Saves XR10/XR11 (bank) and XR0B into [bp+1..3] and sets XR0B bit 2 from BL bit 2 (linear/bank addressing).

1D8E.name: linear_addr_from_cursor
1D8E.comment: Row AH x columns x bytes-per-char-row (40:485) + column AL -> bank BL / offset SI for the extended modes (CL = bytes/pixel shift).

1DE3.name: page_linear_addr
1DE3.comment: ES := A000h; cursor of page BH -> linear_addr_from_cursor.

1DF8.name: pixel_addr_8bpp
1DF8.comment: Row DX x columns x 8 + CX -> bank (xr10_write_bl) and offset BX.

1E2A.name: pixel_addr_1bpp
1E2A.comment: BX>>3 + row DX x columns -> bank/offset for monochrome extended modes.

1F7E.name: xr28_write_mode_bits
1F7E.comment: XR28 := BH with bit 4 set for modes 30h-5Fh and >77h; XR19 := CH when the panel is active.

1FA7.name: xr28_bit5_cond
1FA7.comment: CH := 4Ch, BH |= 20h when CF was set.

1FAF.name: panel_mode_check_advance_di
1FAF.comment: mode_needs_panel_check; when true skips 4 table bytes (DI += 4) and returns CF.

1FC3.name: mode_needs_panel_check
1FC3.comment: CF=1 when XR0F bit 6 is clear, the mode is in mode_in_panel_list and the panel is active.

22F6.name: xr05_program_from_bx
22F6.comment: XR05 bits 3-4 := (BX>>4) & 0Fh shifted, bit 5 cleared (clock select).

232C.name: panel_regs_table_1DB_and_beep
232C.comment: Loads the register list at 01DBh (ct_regs_load_list) and beeps 50 ticks.

23A5.name: panel_config_table_select
23A5.comment: XR6C bit 9 and XR0F bits 0-1 select the panel configuration list at 01E7h.

242C.name: mode_table_select_1E1_1ED
242C.comment: Register list at 01E1h (AL & 7 == 0) or 01EDh (AL == 0), else index AL x 6.

2458.name: panel_regs_table_by_type
2458.comment: XR44 panel type -> list 020Bh (CRT) / 0205h (panel) with a per-type offset from word 0211h; no panel -> 01F3h/01F9h.

2492.name: ct_regs_load_list
2492.comment: Screen off, CX (index, value) words from CS:SI written to 3D6h, screen on.

24A5.name: init_set_default_mode
24A5.comment: ROM byte 019Bh bit 7: sets the default mode (bits 0-6) with INT 10h AH=0 unless already active.

24CE.name: init_option_flags_check
24CE.comment: ROM byte 017Eh bit 7 -> reads port 85h bit 1 (jumper via DMA page register 85h); byte 017Bh bit 4 ...

253B.name: print_string_cs_si_teletype
253B.comment: INT 10h AH=0Eh BL=7 for each byte at CS:SI until NUL.

254B.name: vram_test_setup
254B.comment: Frame with bank_regs_save_set; GC 02h := FFh, XR0B := 01h ... prepares the video-memory test.

25EF.name: vram_bank_test_scan
25EF.comment: Writes 0..15 through bank BL (xr10_write_bl_b) and verifies (also through bank BH).

28DB.name: vram_test_prepare
28DB.comment: mode_param_ptr_for_al, mode_regs_program_all, ES := A000h, GC 05h := 08h, GC 02h/SEQ 02h := 0Fh, DAC mask := 0, SI := 1000h.

2902.name: vga_enable_46E8_3C3
2902.comment: Unless XR70 == 80h: enables the adapter through 46E8h/3C3h (setup mode) with interrupts off.

2981.name: detect_crt_mono_color
2981.comment: ROM flag 017Fh bit 4 or CRTC probes at 3B4h/3D4h (crtc_reg_probe): sets misc output 23h/A6h, 40:463, 40:410 bits 4-5, 40:487 bit 1, 40:489 bit 0.

29E4.name: crtc_reg_probe
29E4.comment: Writes/reads CRTC 0Eh with several values at DX to detect a CRTC.

2A11.name: mode_control_3D8_3B8_disable
2A11.comment: Screen off, then CGA/MDA mode control 3D8h := 0 / 3B8h := 1 (legacy adapters off).

2A55.name: vram_test_pattern_fill
2A55.comment: GC setup and FFh/00h fill pattern at ES:DI for the memory test.

2A78.name: vram_plane_test
2A78.comment: For each plane (GC 02h map mask, all planes when ROM 017Fh bit 3): fills SI bytes twice with FFh/00h and verifies; ZF on success.

2AB1.name: wait_display_enable_toggle
2AB1.comment: Waits for 3xAh bit 0 to go 1 then 0 (FFh in AL on timeout).

2AC7.name: wait_vsync_toggle
2AC7.comment: Waits for 3xAh bit 3 to go 1 then 0 with retries.

2AEA.name: mono_mode_flag_check
2AEA.comment: 40:489 bit 0 (mono) handling before the mode set.

2BBB.name: mode_index_by_adapter_type
2BBB.comment: 40:487 bit 1 and 40:489 bit 0 -> table 2BB7h (initial mode number by adapter type).

2C02.name: nop_push_pop_2C02
2C02.comment: push ax; xor ax,ax; pop ax; ret (hook placeholder).

2EAC.name: ext_mode_set_8_or_9
2EAC.comment: Extended mode handling for [bp+10] = 8/9 through the mode list (save_area_ptr_lookup_mode_list) and font selection.

2EDD.name: int10_00_mode_check_same
2EDD.comment: Compares the requested mode with 40:449 and the adapter flags before re-programming.

3003.name: save_area_pointer_init
3003.comment: Sets the INT 1Fh/43h font pointers (0:10C := 5654h 8x8 font) and the save-area pointer 40:A8.

303D.name: save_area_ptr_setup
303D.comment: Writes the video parameter / save-area pointer table entries (font 5654h for modes > 13h).

30E5.name: save_area_copy_entry4
30E5.comment: Copies 17 bytes of the entry at save-area pointer 4 into ES:BX (alternate table).

3102.name: save_area_ptr_lookup_mode_list
3102.comment: save_area_ptr_get, then mode_in_list_es_bx for the current mode; AL := FFh when not listed.

310A.name: mode_in_list_es_bx
310A.comment: Searches the FFh-terminated mode list at ES:[BX+AX] for the current mode 40:449.

3123.name: alpha_font_override_load
3123.comment: Loads the user alphanumeric font described by the save-area entry (count, start, pointer, segment, height) via attr_packed_dispatch AL=10h and sets 40:484 rows.

3152.name: user_font_check_height
3152.comment: Compares the entry's height with 40:485 before loading.

31EE.name: save_area_ptr_4_user_palette
31EE.comment: Follows save-area pointer 10h (user palette profile) if present.

3285.name: vram_clear_size
3285.comment: CX := 4000h words (or per mode) for clearing video memory.

32DA.name: save_area_ptr_get
32DA.comment: LES DI, 40:A8 (video save pointer table); LES BX, [DI+BX]; ZF when the entry is null.

32F8.name: int10_01_cursor_shape_body
32F8.comment: Cursor shape with the 40:487 bit 3 emulation handling.

3B5F.name: expand_byte_to_pixels
3B5F.comment: Doubles/expands a font byte into pixel words for the 8x8 graphics character writer.

3B74.name: find_glyph_in_font
3B74.comment: Compares the 8-byte glyph at SI with DX glyphs at ES:DI; DI := glyph index on match.

445D.name: wait_vsync_then_5281
445D.comment: Waits for vertical retrace (3xAh bit 3) then continues at 5281.

447B.name: dac_rgb_gray_scale
447B.comment: Gray-scale summing: R x 30% + G x 59% + B x 11% (weights at 446Eh/4470h).

4710.name: es_cs_dx0_cx100
4710.comment: ES := CS, DX := 0, CX := 256 (palette block preparation).

47DD.name: scanline_sel_0_flag
47DD.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 |= 80h then scanline_sel_0

47E2.name: scanline_sel_0
47E2.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 &= EFh; 40:488 low nibble := 8 (200 lines)

47F2.name: scanline_sel_1
47F2.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 |= 80h, &= EFh; 40:488 nibble := 0Bh

4807.name: scanline_sel_2_flag
4807.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 &= 7Fh then scanline_sel_2

480C.name: scanline_sel_2
480C.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 &= EFh; 40:488 nibble := 9 (350 lines)

481C.name: scanline_sel_3_flag
481C.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant:

4821.name: scanline_sel_3
4821.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:488 nibble := 0Bh

4831.name: scanline_sel_4_flag
4831.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant:

4836.name: scanline_sel_4
4836.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 |= 10h (400 lines); 40:488 nibble := 9

4846.name: scanline_sel_5_flag
4846.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant:

484B.name: scanline_sel_5
484B.comment: INT 10h AH=12h BL=30h scan-line selection variant: 40:489 |= 10h; 40:488 nibble := 0Bh

4958.name: int05_print_screen
4958.comment: INT 05h handler: 40:500 status byte (1 = busy, FFh = error), reads every character with INT 10h AH=08h and prints it through print_screen_char_int17, CR/LF per row.

49D9.name: print_screen_char_int17
49D9.comment: INT 17h AH=0 LPT1; CL := FFh on error status (25h mask).

4DD0.name: save_video_state_regs
4DD0.comment: INT 10h AH=1Ch: sequencer, misc output, CRTC, ATC, GC and DAC registers to ES:DI.

4F68.name: font_plane2_access_open
4F68.comment: SEQ 04h := 06h, GC 05h := 0, 06h := 05h, 08h := FFh - map plane 2 for font access.

50BC.name: atc_write_al_after_3xA
50BC.comment: Reads 3xAh to reset the ATC flip-flop, writes AL to 3C0h, reads 3xAh again.

5152.name: mode_table_group_select
5152.comment: CX := 0/1/2 (VGA 400-line / EGA 350 / CGA 200 tables) from 40:489 bit 4 and 40:488 low nibble.

5179.name: mode_param_ptr_for_al
5179.comment: ES:SI := 64-byte mode parameter block for mode AL: from the ROM lists at 5116h (three 14h-byte lists chosen by mode_table_group_select, index = 40h x entry) plus the user override from save-area pointer 0, or from get_mode_param_ptr for modes > 13h.

51B2.name: mode_regs_program_all
51B2.comment: Screen off, mode_regs_program_seq_misc_crtc, xr57_clear_bit2, mode_set_256color_fix, screen on.

51C6.name: mode_regs_program_seq_misc_crtc
51C6.comment: Writes SEQ 01h-04h, misc output 3C2h (sets 40:463 to 3B4h/3D4h), CRTC 00h-18h, ATC 00h-13h and GC 00h-08h from the parameter block at ES:SI.

529C.name: dac_write_entry
529C.comment: DAC index BL (3C8h), R := AH, G := CH, B := CL (3C9h).

52E1.name: dac_clear_all
52E1.comment: 256 DAC entries := 0 with the screen off.

52F7.name: dac_default_load
52F7.comment: Loads the default palette unless 40:489 bit 3 (palette loading disabled).

5431.name: dac_load_run_list
5431.comment: Table-driven default DAC palette: (count/flags, values) runs; DL bit 3/4 select the 16-colour / 64-colour parts.

5451.name: dac_load_run
5451.comment: One run of the palette table through dac_write_entry.

547C.name: dac_load_gray_runs
547C.comment: Gray ramp: R=G=B from the table.

5491.name: dac_ega_color_map
5491.comment: EGA 6-bit colour (rgbRGB) -> DAC R/G/B through the table at CS:SI.

54DB.name: font_load_to_plane2
54DB.comment: INT 10h AH=11h font load: screen off, SEQ 02h := 04h, SEQ 04h := 07h, GC for plane 2, copies the glyphs (font_copy_rows), restores.

558A.name: font_copy_rows
558A.comment: For CX glyphs: BH bytes from DS:SI to ES:DI, DI += DX (32-byte glyph slots).

5597.name: font_9dot_patch_load
5597.comment: For 9-dot text (BL bits 6-7, XR55 bit 2 clear): overwrites the glyphs listed at 6C54h (8x14) or 7D64h (8x16) - characters whose 9th column must repeat the 8th (box-drawing set).

55E5.name: font_block_addr
55E5.comment: DI := A000 offset of font block BL (0-7, 8 KB blocks interleaved) + DX x 32.

5610.name: font_plane2_access_close
5610.comment: SEQ 02h := 03h, SEQ 04h := 03h, GC 04h := 0, 05h := 10h, 06h := 0Eh - back to text-mode plane mapping.

47D8.name: scanline_sel_0_pre
47D8.comment: Entry 2 of int10_12_ext_dispatch: falls into scanline_sel_0_flag.

48CE.name: int10_12_3x_sub_0
48CE.comment: Sub-function 0 of the int10_12_bl3x_dispatch group: 40:489 bit 6 handling.

0C61.name: mode_set_frag_0C61
0C61.comment: push ax/dx; call; jz - fragment of the mode-set path.

0D34.name: mode_set_frag_0D34
0D34.comment: call 2028h; push bx; jmp - fragment inside the 5Fh display-configuration path.

1CC1.name: frame_call_tail_1CC1
1CC1.comment: mov bp,sp; call ...; add sp,4; pop bp; ret (tail of a frame-using pixel routine).

1D84.name: frame_call_tail_1D84
1D84.comment: mov bp,sp; call; add sp,4; pop bp; ret - tail of a frame-using pixel routine (second copy).

0B4B.name: ct_ext_reg_lists
0B4B.comment: (XR index, value) byte pairs terminated by 00 00: per-mode/panel extension-register settings (e.g. 44h 10h, 45h 00h, 4Fh 04h, 58h 00h, 59h 84h...).

0C2A.name: str_evaluation_use_only
0C2A.comment: 'For Evaluation Use Only.\r\n' - the C&T BIOS build is marked as an evaluation release.

0CFA.name: mode_set_frag_0CFA
0CFA.comment: test bl,08h; jne - unreached remnant of the mode-set flag handling.

23A2.name: push_pop_si_ret
23A2.comment: push si; pop si; ret (hook placeholder).

2BB7.name: initial_mode_table
2BB7.comment: 0Ch 0Bh 0Eh 0Dh - initial mode number by adapter type (mode_index_by_adapter_type).

468A.name: table_468A
468A.comment: 0Dh 18h 2Ah - character heights / offsets used by the palette code.

7FFF.name: rom_checksum_byte
7FFF.comment: D7h - makes the 32 KB video ROM sum to zero (8-bit).
